description: Newest items, optionally narrowed to a collection, source or kind.

bbox.description: west,south,east,north; west > east crosses the antimeridian

before_id.description: Keyset cursor: the smallest item id from the previous page, e.g. 81234567; not with sort=distance

kind.description: Item kind, e.g. release, title, filing (optional)

limit.description: Rows to return, integer 1-200, default 30, e.g. 50

offset.description: Rows to skip when sort=distance, integer, e.g. 30

sort.description: Result order. distance (needs lat and long) puts the nearest first, e.g. "distance"; anything else keeps newest first

name: recent_items
